text:
[NDBG.14.1.1] Changes the step granularity for the current session.

Request:
```json
{ "granularity": "action" | "rule" | "pump" | "input" }
```

- `"action"` — one RHS action. Replay only.
- `"rule"` — one whole firing, every RHS action of it. Replay only.
- `"pump"` — one pump, to its settled point. The engine asserts one clock
  tick per pump ([IRET.19.5]), so this is also the clock-tick step.
- `"input"` — to the next input the trace or the fact files feed the engine.

The adapter must refuse `"action"` and `"rule"` in a live session, with an
error saying they are replay only. The default is `"action"` in replay and
`"pump"` live. When the session changes mode, the granularity becomes the new
mode's default unless the client has set one the new mode admits.

A live step with no input left to feed must leave the session paused, and the
adapter says so in an `output` event.
